description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the MacGatewayChatTransport module, specifically testing the mapping of various push notification events to internal transport event representations in the OpenClaw chat application.

classes.name: MacGatewayChatTransportMappingTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for verifying the correctness of event mappings within the MacGatewayChatTransport module.

methods.name: `snapshot maps to health`
methods.description: Tests that a snapshot event correctly maps to a health transport event.

methods.name: `health event maps to health`
methods.description: Verifies that a health event properly maps to a health transport event with expected 'ok' status.

methods.name: `tick event maps to tick`
methods.description: Checks if a tick event maps accurately to the tick transport event.

methods.name: `chat event maps to chat`
methods.description: Ensures that a chat event with specific payload fields maps to the correct chat transport event.

methods.name: `unknown event maps to nil`
methods.description: Tests that an unrecognized event type results in a nil mapping.

methods.name: `seq gap maps to seq gap`
methods.description: Confirms that a sequence gap notification maps appropriately to a sequence gap transport event.
